description: Search unified method names by keyword, or get one method's signature and parameter documentation. With "exchange" it adds that exchange's own docs (including supported params.* keys and links to the exchange API reference), per-market-type feature support, and searches its implicit (exchange-specific) endpoints too. Full ccxt manual: https://docs.ccxt.com/

exchange.description: exchange id for per-exchange docs, feature support and implicit endpoints; when omitted a reference exchange (binance) is used, so implicit-endpoint results are binance-specific — pass "exchange" to search another

method.description: exact method name to describe, e.g. "fetchOHLCV" (or an implicit endpoint name when "exchange" is set)

prediction.description: set true to use the prediction-markets variant of an exchange that exists in both namespaces (e.g. hyperliquid)

query.description: keyword search over method names, e.g. "funding"

name: describe_method
title: Search or describe unified ccxt methods
